messages:
Alex K: kicking off deploy v2.3.1 -> production. rolling canary to 1% with ff:rt-model-routing=true. change window ends 02:30 UTC.
Deploy-Bot: deploy started - id: deploy-1738889999 - jobs: canary, rollout. status: IN_PROGRESS.
Mia Li: FYI telemetry alerting hooked to the canary cohort. watching latency and 5xx.
ops-bot: Canary metrics update (5m): latency +8% vs baseline, 5xx rate 0.12% -> baseline 0.03% (alert threshold 0.1%).
Diego R: seeing a small spike on the reranker path, likely kv cache miss with the new model. increasing batch size => might help but not during canary.
Sara N: can we soft-disable traffic to the new route only for premium cohort? we should preserve free tier.
Alex K: yes. plan: pin premium to previous routing while we investigate. set ff:rt-model-routing=off for cohort=premium.
Mia Li: ran the toggle: `curl -XPOST https://config-api/flags/rt-model-routing/toggle -d '{"cohort":"premium","state":"off"}'` -> 200 OK.
Deploy-Bot: flag change applied; rollout continuing for other cohorts.
ops-bot: Canary metrics update (10m): overall 5xx down to 0.04%, latency back to +2%. Good signal.
QA Bot: quick smoke on a sample of premium users shows expected responses. no regressions in QA prompts.
Diego R: still seeing occasional reranker mismatch logs: `WARNING rerank: kv-cache-miss model=v2.3.1 shard=3` - looks harmless but noisy.
Alex K: decision time: leave canary open for another 30m and keep premium pinned to v2.3.0. If errors resurface, rollback full rollout.
Mia Li: adding to release notes: "Rolling canary: v2.3.1, premium users pinned to v2.3.0 due to kv-cache mismatch; monitoring in progress" - tracking ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2042
Sara N: tagging oncall for potential rollback: @Diego R @Mia Li @ops-oncall
Deploy-Bot: scheduled automatic rollback in 60m if critical errors > threshold. To cancel: `deploy cancel-rollback deploy-1738889999`.
Alex K: thanks. also adding a follow-up task to tighten quantization compatibility tests for reranker models.
Diego R: ack. I'll collect the offending logs and open a patch if needed.
Mia Li: once we're confident, we'll unpin premium with a gradual 5%->25%->100% ramp and update the release notes.
Alex K: agreed. keeping this thread as the single source for decisions.
Sara N: marking as :white_check_mark: for now.
Deploy-Bot: deploy-1738889999 status: PARTIAL_ROLLOUT (canary stable, premium pinned). will post final status after the change window.
